clue.text: You alone cut short poetry

definitions.note: a pronoun standing for the noun: the setter addresses the people doing the puzzle

indicators.note: something cut short loses its end, so each of the two words drops its final letter

parts.note: alone, unaccompanied
poetry in general

explanation.surface: A grumble that someone, on their own, has trimmed a poem.
explanation.walkthrough: SOLO and VERSE each lose a last letter to give SOL + VERS. The setter is talking to whoever is doing the crossword: you are the solvers.
explanation.definitionFit: The people a crossword setter addresses as 'you' are the puzzle's solvers.

clue.text: Thin line interrupting the start of Sid James's intro

definitions.note: an adjective, while SLIM JIM is a noun for a thin person

indicators.note: to interrupt is to break into the middle of something, so one piece sits inside another
the start of a word is its opening letter, so only that is kept

parts.note: first letter of Sid
L is the standard abbreviation for line
how a James called Jim would introduce himself: 'I'm Jim'

explanation.surface: The comic actor Sid James being interrupted mid-introduction by a skinny line.
explanation.walkthrough: L breaks into S + I'M JIM, landing straight after the S, to give SLIM JIM. Sid James was a British comic actor of the Carry On films; 'Sid' here only supplies its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A slim jim is an informal name for a very lean, lanky person, so the phrase describes someone thin.

clue.text: Upcoming new charge will be 5a for me!

definitions.note: the speaker of the clue, a prisoner serving a life sentence

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means the word is read from the bottom to the top

parts.note: a new charge, as of ink, fuel or a glass

explanation.surface: A prisoner protesting that one more charge would simply be too much for him.
explanation.walkthrough: Read upwards, REFILL becomes LLIFER, which has one L too much; the clue's '5a' (TOO MUCH) is the hint to shed it. The bloggers noted the setter seems to rely on that surplus letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The speaker is a lifer, a prisoner serving a life term, for whom any extra charge would be excessive.

clue.text: "Master Race"? Only 30 per cent are human

definitions.note: a verb phrase; the proverb says to err is human, so erring is what humans do

indicators.note: a small fraction of the ten-letter phrase is kept, three consecutive letters from its middle

parts.note: letters 4 to 6 of the ten-letter phrase

explanation.surface: A dig at the idea of a 'master race': only a minority of them are actually human beings.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on the proverb 'To err is human, to forgive divine'.
explanation.definitionFit: Erring, making mistakes, is proverbially the defining trait of being human.

clue.text: In strike-breaking is rat still tipping the scales?

definitions.note: Libra, the Scales, is one example of the answer

indicators.note: tipping something over turns it upside down, so in a down clue the letters read upwards
the answer is sitting inside the run of words that follows

parts.note: the letters spanning the end of breaking, all of is and rat, and the s of still

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a scab who breaks a strike is still swinging the balance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rat' looks like the strike-breaker of the surface, but it is just letters for the run. The question mark flags that the scales is an example: Libra.
explanation.definitionFit: Libra, whose symbol is the Scales, is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac.

clue.text: Details I didn't need to feature with maiden refined in love making

indicators.note: in places the preceding group of letters inside the following ones

parts.note: taken as written
love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O
M is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for a maiden over
U means upper-class, hence refined
the chin is a facial feature
the making or forming of something

explanation.surface: Someone describing a romantic encounter in more detail than wanted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Love making' looks like one phrase from the surface, but split it gives two pieces that wrap the middle section. The phrase is the modern retort, often shortened to TMI, to an overshare.
explanation.definitionFit: The exclamation is a stock way of telling someone they have overshared personal matters that the listener did not want to hear.

clue.text: Mind-blowing pressure added to one with power to cut strain

indicators.note: cutting into something goes inside it, so these letters sit within the outer word

parts.note: to try is to strain or make an effort
Roman numeral one
P is the physics symbol for pressure
P is the symbol for power

explanation.surface: An engineer's description of a stunning device that adds pressure and power to relieve strain.
explanation.definitionFit: Trippy is slang for psychedelic, like the hallucinatory effects of a drug trip, so mind-blowing.

clue.text: Wearing old anorak with flower, I may take my car out

definitions.text: I may take my car out

indicators.note: the pieces that follow have the first one on, so they surround it

parts.note: O is the abbreviation for old
W is the abbreviation for with
an anorak is an obsessive enthusiast
a flower here is something that flows

explanation.surface: Someone in an old anorak with a flower in it about to go for a drive.
explanation.walkthrough: W sits between O and NERD. In British slang an anorak is a geek, from the coats trainspotters wear; a 'flower' is a crossword river.
explanation.definitionFit: An owner-driver is someone who both owns a vehicle and drives it, free to take their own car out.

clue.text: What liberates you in sound, note and key

indicators.note: in sound means as heard, so the word is replaced by a letter pronounced the same

parts.note: the letter U is said like the word you
NB, nota bene, means take note
a key is a thing that locks

explanation.surface: A musical riddle about what sets you free in the sound of a note and key.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Note' and 'key' suggest music; here they are NB and a device that locks.
explanation.definitionFit: An unblocker, like a drain or nasal unblocker, clears an obstruction, freeing whatever was stuck.

clue.text: Second chapter withdrawn from Marlowe yarn?

indicators.note: withdrawing from something removes it, so these letters are taken away

parts.note: Raymond Chandler wrote the Philip Marlowe detective stories
C is the abbreviation for chapter

explanation.surface: A second chapter pulled from a Marlowe story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Marlowe' suggests the playwright Christopher Marlowe; it is Raymond Chandler's private eye. 'Second chapter' reads as one phrase, but Second is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: In boxing a second is the trainer or handler who attends a fighter between rounds.

clue.text: See 5
The main point about this hairstyle

indicators.note: about can mean turned round, so the word is written back to front

parts.note: the nub is the crux or central point

explanation.surface: Asking what the whole point of a particular hairdo is.
explanation.definitionFit: A bun is a hairstyle where the hair is gathered into a round coil at the back of the head.

clue.text: Our suspect framed by Jack Reacher's principal court figure

indicators.note: a frame surrounds a picture, so the middle letters sit between the outer pieces
suspect as an adjective means dubious, so the letters are not to be trusted in their given order

parts.note: J is the card abbreviation for a jack
the three letters rearranged

indicators.note: the principal letter is the first, so only the opening of the name is used

parts.note: first letter of Reacher

explanation.surface: A suspect caught and framed by the fictional vigilante Jack Reacher, then brought before the court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jack Reacher' reads as the Lee Child hero but splits into a card abbreviation and an initial.
explanation.definitionFit: A juror is one of the members of a jury, a central figure in a courtroom trial.

clue.text: Novel is not read on purpose!

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters are made into something fresh

parts.note: the letters to rearrange
re means on or concerning, as in a memo heading

explanation.surface: Someone protesting that they deliberately avoided reading a novel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On purpose' looks like one phrase meaning deliberately, but 'on' is wordplay and 'purpose' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A raison d'être, French for 'reason for being', is the main purpose or justification of something's existence.

clue.text: Big game reserve in which to see a predator of the night

indicators.note: the first word is a place inside which the next piece can be seen, so one goes within the other

parts.note: a sub, or substitute, is a reserve player
a as in 'five pounds a head' means per
the owl hunts at night

explanation.surface: A wildlife reserve for big game where you might spot an owl hunting after dark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Big game' looks like the safari of the surface, but it is the definition. The SUPER BOWL is the championship game of American football.
explanation.definitionFit: The Super Bowl is the annual championship match of the NFL, the biggest single game in American sport.

clue.text: Who's sealing the deal to get Man United?

definitions.text: Who's sealing the deal to get Man United?

parts.words: Who's sealing the deal to get Man United?
parts.note: surface reading: a football agent or club owner closing a deal to buy Manchester United

parts.words: Who's sealing the deal to get Man United?
parts.note: setter's reading: someone paid to arrange a match so that a man is united with a wife

explanation.surface: A business tycoon trying to close a takeover of Manchester United football club.
explanation.walkthrough: Man United, the usual nickname of Manchester United, splits into 'man' and 'united', as in wed.
explanation.definitionFit: This professional arranges matches between people seeking a spouse, uniting a man with a partner for a fee.

clue.text: Aussie resident gets floor scrubbed in fetid shared apartment

definitions.note: a noun phrase for the arrangement; ROOMING-IN names the practice of lodging in shared accommodation

indicators.note: in a down clue the floor is the bottom letter, and scrubbing it out removes it

parts.note: a kangaroo, a native resident of Australia
minging is British slang for foul-smelling or disgusting

explanation.surface: An Australian lodger has to clean the floor of a smelly flat he shares.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Aussie resident' looks like a person; it is the kangaroo. Minging is British slang for smelly.
explanation.definitionFit: Rooming in means lodging, renting a room in a house or flat where facilities are shared.

clue.text: See 14
Jack Dee I refuse in writing

indicators.note: in puts the preceding letters inside the following word

parts.note: prose is ordinary written language
the letter dee spelt out
the word of refusal

explanation.surface: The deadpan comic Jack Dee turning down a request to put something in writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jack Dee' reads as the British comedian, but Jack is the definition: slang for a detective.
explanation.definitionFit: Prodnose is old slang for a detective or busybody, and jack is slang for a detective or policeman.

clue.text: Wise words from Solomon Roberts about fine fellow cycling past

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the outer piece goes round the rest
cycling moves letters round in a loop, so the front letters go to the back

parts.note: Bob is a pet form of Robert, so several Roberts are Bobs
OK means fine or all right
a professor is an academic fellow, PROF for short
over means past or finished

explanation.surface: A man called Solomon Roberts holding forth about a fine chap riding past on a bike.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solomon Roberts' reads as one name, but Solomon belongs to the definition and Roberts starts the wordplay. The fellow is a professor, whose letters loop round before going inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Testament Book of Proverbs, a collection of wise sayings, is traditionally attributed to King Solomon.

clue.text: Looking up commonest of cyclamens in Vol 1 of Encyclopaedia of Plants?

indicators.note: in a down clue, looking up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: C is the only letter appearing twice in cyclamens
taken as written
the first volume of an encyclopaedia typically covers A to B

explanation.surface: Consulting the first volume of a plant encyclopaedia for cyclamens.
explanation.walkthrough: C + IN + A TO B, read upwards. 'Encyclopaedia of Plants' looks like one title; 'of Plants' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Botanic means relating to plants or botany, as in botanic gardens.

clue.text: See 18
The latest synthetic applied by aerosol?

parts.note: SP, the starting price, is the latest odds offered on a horse before a race
rayon is a synthetic fabric

explanation.surface: The newest man-made product, dispensed from a spray can.
explanation.definitionFit: A spray-on product is one applied by spraying, typically from an aerosol can.

clue.text: One for whom fitness was paramount convulsing in ward

definitions.text: One for whom fitness was paramount

indicators.note: convulsing means jerking violently, so the letters are thrown into disorder

parts.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A fitness fanatic suffering a fit on a hospital ward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fitness' suggests the gym; it is Darwinian fitness, the survival of the fittest.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles Darwin's theory of natural selection made fitness, the ability to survive and reproduce, the central idea.

clue.text: Appreciation of second encore passed on down the line?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a round of applause is a hand, and the applause for a second encore is the third such hand
second meaning: information relayed through more than one intermediary

explanation.surface: An audience's applause for a second encore, passed along the row.
explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is cryptic: a performance gets a hand, the first encore another, and the second encore the third.
explanation.definitionFit: News heard third-hand has come through two intermediaries, relayed down a chain of people rather than directly.

clue.text: One likely to pip others in smart car?

definitions.text: One likely to pip others in smart car?

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the next one

parts.note: RR stands for Rolls-Royce, the smartest of cars
an ace counts as one in cards and has a single pip

explanation.surface: A driver in a flashy car who is liable to beat everyone else.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay. 'Pip' backs up the card reading of One: an ace is the card with a single pip, and Rolls-Royce is the byword for a smart car.
explanation.definitionFit: A racer is a competitor or vehicle built to win, likely to beat rivals by a narrow margin in a fast car.

clue.text: Long-distance traveller not quite reaching wake

indicators.note: falling just short means the last letter is lost

parts.note: to come to is to regain consciousness

explanation.surface: A long-haul traveller who falls short of the wake of a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A comet travels vast distances on its orbit around the sun, out to the furthest reaches of the solar system.

clue.text: Repeatedly find fault with horse

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to scold or pester persistently
second meaning: an old or worn-out horse

explanation.surface: Constantly criticising one's horse.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to carp or badger persistently, and the noun is an informal word for a horse, especially a poor one.

clue.text: I'm not certain of recipient in contact or why memo needs redirecting

indicators.note: redirecting sends things on a new route, so the letters are put in a new order

parts.note: the words to rearrange
also part of the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: Someone uncertain who a misdirected memo was meant for or why it needs re-sending.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase heads a letter whose writer does not know the specific person who will receive or deal with it.

clue.text: Waving goodbye to son, drink a beer

indicators.note: someone waved goodbye has left, so that letter is removed

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son
a sip is a small drink
taken as written

explanation.surface: A parent waving their son off, then settling down to a pint.
explanation.definitionFit: IPA, India Pale Ale, is a strongly hopped style of pale beer.

clue.text: See 26
Shape is resumed thanks to this No 11 joining England's opener

definitions.text: Shape is resumed thanks to this

indicators.note: an opener comes first, so only the initial letter is taken

parts.note: first letter of England
in cricket the number 11 batsman is the last in to bat

explanation.surface: A cricket team's number eleven batsman joining England's opening batsman at the crease.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the opener bats first and the No 11 last, so 'opener' and 'No 11' both look like players; one gives a letter, the other the phrase LAST IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Elastin is the protein in skin and tissue that lets them stretch and then spring back to their original form.
